payload.title: Remove the remaining quadratic board-load callers (ready, dep add, dep tree, update --type)
payload.description: Board load remainder of kbs-73f796e3: kbs ready, kbs dep add, kbs dep tree and kbs update --type still load or scan the board per issue. Make each load the board once per command in both runtimes, with identical output, and add a performance regression check alongside the existing performance CI job.
